newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: FORECAST - Uzbek 1997 budget deficit 3 pct of GDP.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Uzbek 1997 budget deficit 3 pct of GDP.

text.p: Uzbekistan's budget deficit for 1997 is forecast at around three percent of gross domestic product, official sources said on Thursday.
Finance Minister Bakhtier Khamidov presented the 1997 budget to parliament on Thursday, and the sources said spending would total around 26.8 billion sum.
But they added Khamidov did not give full details of the budget to deputies.
The resource-rich Central Asian republic is secretive about its economic activity. But deputies are expected to approve the budget as President Islam Karimov has strong executive powers.

Last week, the International Monetary Fund announced it had suspended a loan to Uzbekistan, criticising the former Soviet republic for not keeping to inflation targets and for maintaining foreign exchange controls.
The sum traded officially at 54.50 sums to the dollar on Thursday while the black market rate was around 105-110 sums to the dollar.
